status: WIP: source-policy alignment, not an accepted throughput win
source: client-go internal/client/conn_batch.go fetchAllPendingRequests, fetchMorePendingRequests and batchSendLoop; client_test.go TestBatchPolicy

method.workload: sysbench oltp_read_only; 100000 rows; prepared statements; same TiKV
method.cpu: ps cumulative process CPU differences over equal work; SQL and TiKV measured separately
method.batch_size: TiKV request histogram counter deltas after each trial

candidates.name: initial per-store event-loop collector
candidates.decision: Eight-client regression prevents acceptance. Source review also found the timer stayed armed after reaching the target and the post-yield drain was missing.

candidates.name: timer cancellation and final drain refinement
candidates.decision: CPU reductions do not establish throughput improvement. Eight-client regression remains. The 32-client control drifts from 2800.91 to 2569.70 TPS, so that tier is not acceptance-quality evidence. Do not compare candidates across different windows as a causal timing control.

parity.coverage: Six query outputs, 307 text lines, identical on Go/control/candidate before and after both measurement windows. Not exhaustive metadata, package parity or TPC-C write evidence.

latency.limitation: Every retained sysbench trial prints 95th percentile 0.00 despite multi-millisecond mean latency. This is unavailable tail-latency evidence, not zero latency. The updated objective requires both throughput and latency acceptance; verify the latency measurement path before the next acceptance run.

profiles.method: Separate 15-second Rust Time Profiler captures and Go pprof capture at eight clients, outside the timed trials. Rust analysis uses Running state and nanosecond weights; transport root includes the LTO-inlined owner-thread closure in both binaries.
profiles.finding: Transport-owner CPU weight falls; the refined collector introduces semaphore_timedwait_trap under that owner. Go batchSendLoop includes fetchMorePendingRequests, selectgo and timer/wakeup work. These CPU captures do not measure per-request waiting time or prove which wait causes the latency regression.

validation.refined_additional_checks: cargo test --offline --locked --release -j12 -p tidb-txnkv --test all followed by transport_authority_concurrency_source (2 passed), tikv_active_cancellation_source (1 passed), or tikv_unary_command_source (2 passed). Logs: concurrency-refined.log, cancellation-refined.log, unary-refined.log under /private/tmp/tidb-batch-owner.Lf2c27. One concurrency case also belongs to batch_.
validation.limitations: Initial sandbox socket tests failed with Operation not permitted; authorized host rerun passed. One refined unit invocation used the wrong Cargo directory and was rerun correctly. Ready lint and whole-package completion are not claimed.

remaining: Measure the collection/admission/response critical path against Go and reconcile scheduler ownership without workload-specific wait tuning. Verify both throughput and latency, including a trustworthy tail-latency measurement. General prepared-plan reuse and TPC-C remain open.
